stage_b.h120_rule: With 120 stored frames, start=0, and context=2, only 118 predicted frames are available. H120 is reported as effective horizon 118; no episode is extrapolated beyond data.

stage_c.selection_rule: Deterministic contiguous episode IDs 3..12, excluding repeatedly used IDs 0..2. This set was frozen before campaign execution and is not used to choose parameters.

stage_d.conditional_cr1_v2_context1: Run only if context=1 CR0 has no instability and aggregate H40 MSE <= 1.25 times the CR0 context=2 seed mean.
